subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be completed as docs/help for the existing Shift+Enter and Ctrl+J behavior, or should OpenClaw also add a public TUI submit-key preference?
rationale: The core multiline behavior already exists, but configurable submission adds permanent config or CLI surface under the repository’s high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document Existing Bindings
options.body: Add accurate TUI docs and `/help` text for Enter, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and terminal limitations without adding configuration.

options.title: Add Submit Preference
options.body: Also expose a narrow TUI submit-key preference with current defaults preserved and compatibility-focused tests.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Bindings
recommendation.body: Add accurate TUI docs and `/help` text for Enter, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and terminal limitations without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history signal across the editor, help, docs, and the existing issue discussion.
